name: text-highlight
title: Text Highlight
description: Highlight React text with a hand-placed marker band that sweeps in and tracks wrapping lines.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)
theme.font-display: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

light.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

dark.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/text-highlight.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add text-highlight.
